sources.title: Passport, Aadhaar, Social Media Ban? PIL In Madras HC Puts CJP Leader Saurav Das’s Identity, Nationality Un - News18
sources.articleText:
The Madras High Court has issued notices to the Union Government, law enforcement agencies, and Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) spokesperson Saurav Das following a Public Interest Litigation (PIL). The plea seeks a thorough probe into Das’s identity, background, and alleged derogatory remarks against the judiciary, alongside requests to block his social media handles.
A division bench comprising Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G Arul Murugan entertained preliminary submissions before issuing formal notices, making them returnable in six weeks.
Filed by Chennai resident R Ganesh Kumar, the petition alleges that Das has repeatedly made contemptuous statements targeting the Supreme Court of India, the Chief Justice of India, and sitting judges across public platforms. Represented by advocate B Jagannath, the petitioner argued that despite submitting formal complaints to central authorities in early October, no action had been taken.
The PIL specifically prays for directions to the Ministry of Home Affairs to verify Das’s family background, credentials, and nationality . Furthermore, it requests the cancellation of his passport and Aadhaar card if any wrongdoing or nationality discrepancy is uncovered, while seeking immediate orders to block his accounts on X and Instagram.
The High Court’s intervention marks a sharp escalation in legal scrutiny surrounding the CJP leader. Das and party co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka were previously detained by police following a protest near Jantar Mantar in New Delhi, spending a week in judicial custody before securing bail on personal bonds.
